title: Copying and moving a Buffer
description: You can follow separate allocation during copying and pointer transfer during moving.

steps.description: Buffer allocates an integer array and deletes it in its destructor. Its copy constructor allocates a separate array and copies the source elements.
The move constructor takes the source size and pointer. You then see it set the source size to zero and its pointer to nullptr.
The assignment operators first release the destination's array. make_buffer constructs a local Buffer, stores 99 in its first element and returns it.

steps.question: After constructing c from std::move(a), which object holds a's original array?
steps.answer: c holds the original pointer. The supplied move constructor leaves a with size zero and a null pointer, while b keeps its separate copy.

steps.description: You see one copy message and one move message before Buffer(8) is constructed. This recording adds no move message for the returned local, then prints four destruction messages.
